blocks.title: Voice shopping API semantics
rows: Audio over a WebSocket opened on the tap, with a token fetched after consent
Buffer audio until the socket opens; a null result skips the model
POST /intent with the transcript and the context
Validate it; choice options must be facet values, and an answer merges into the pending patch
Commit the draft and render; at total 0 keep the chips and offer Undo

blocks.title: Accessible voice and text input
blocks.text: The talk and consent taps call unlock(), which resumes audio and primes speechSynthesis inside the gesture. Talk keeps its name, aria-pressed is true only while listening, and a denied or missing microphone sets aria-disabled with the reason in aria-describedby. Partial text is not live and focus stays put when listening starts; headphones keep a screen reader out of the microphone. Choices and Undo are buttons, spoken replies can be switched off, and the listening animation respects reduced motion.
